action: press 'Up' -- move the New Game selection up off Preset Character and onto Custom Character
commentary: I am not taking a person off a shelf. If I have to be someone, I will be built by hand.

action: press 'Return' -- take the Custom Character entry
commentary: Right then. Let us see what I look like written down.

action: press 'f' -- finish the world settings as they stand
commentary: I have no opinions about how the world is shaped. It is the one I woke up in.

action: press 'Y' -- confirm the world at a case-sensitive prompt that wants a capital
commentary: Yes. I am finished deciding about the shape of the world.

action: press 'shift+Tab' -- step back to the points page before choosing anything else
commentary: If I am going to be honest about my own weight I want to see the ledger first.

action: press 'Down' -- move down off the freeform budget onto the multiple-pools budget
commentary: I do not want a version of myself with no limits. That is not a person, it is a wish.

action: press 'Return' -- take the multiple-pools budget so every gain has to be paid for
commentary: If I am strong somewhere I should be paying for it somewhere else. That is how it has always worked.

action: press 'Tab' -- move on to the scenario page
press 'slash' -- open the filter on the list of starts
commentary: There is a long list here and I know the one I want.

action: press 'm' -- begin spelling the start I am looking for

commentary: I did not get out. That is the truth of it, so that is the one I take.

action: press 'Tab' -- move on to the profession page
press 'slash' -- open the filter on the trades
commentary: I already know the answer to this one.
H. Fisher. Thirty-one seasons of it.
Thirty-one seasons. It is the only honest answer.

action: press 'Tab' -- move on from the trade
press 'Tab' -- move on to the stats page

commentary: Thirty-one years of hauling traps over a gunwale. This is the one thing nobody can argue with me about.
I can still put a full trap on the rail without thinking about it.

action: press 'Down' -- move down to dexterity and leave it alone
commentary: My hands are ordinary. I have never been quick, only steady.
I left school at sixteen for the boats and I have felt the lack of it ever since. Anything out of a book comes to me slowly.
And here is what I got instead.
I can read a change in the water at half a mile.
I notice things before I have decided to. It is the only talent I would claim.

action: press 'Tab' -- move on to the traits page
commentary: Now what is wrong with me, and what is right.

action: press 'slash' -- open the filter on the traits
commentary: Start with the thing that will kill me.

action: press 'b' -- begin spelling the first flaw

commentary: There it is, in a list, like a diagnosis.
Six years of it. There is a way of lifting with a twist that will put me on the floor and I still do it when I am tired.
And the other thing I have always known about myself.

action: press 's' -- begin spelling the second flaw

commentary: Let us see it written down.
I slept in a bunk over a running diesel for thirty-one years. I have never once woken to a noise, and out here that is going to cost me.

action: press 'a' -- begin spelling the third flaw

commentary: T. It runs straight down my mother side of the family.

action: press 'Down' -- move down past the resistant one to the addictive one
commentary: That is the wrong way round. I am not the resistant kind.
The boats ran on coffee and cigarettes and I have never pretended either was under control.

action: press 'slash' -- open the filter for what is right with me
press 't' -- begin spelling the first boon

commentary: H. I do not break easily.
I have been thrown against a gunwale in a February swell and gone back to work the same afternoon.

action: press 's' -- begin spelling the second boon
press 'Up' -- move up off the weak stomach
press 'Up' -- move up again to the strong one

commentary: I have eaten what was available my whole working life and it has never once betrayed me.

action: press 'o' -- begin spelling the third boon
press 'Escape' -- clear the filter, which found nothing for what I was looking for
press 'slash' -- open the filter again; nothing on the screen changed
press 'p' -- begin spelling it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'a' -- continue spelling it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'c' -- continue spelling it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'k' -- continue spelling it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'm' -- finish spelling it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'Escape' -- clear the filter and leave the traits as they stand
commentary: That is enough honesty for one page.

action: press 'Tab' -- move on to the skills page; nothing on the screen changed
commentary: And what I can actually do.

action: press 'slash' -- open the filter on the skills; nothing on the screen changed
press 's' -- begin spelling it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'w' -- continue spelling it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'i' -- continue spelling it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'm' -- finish spelling it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'Tab' -- move on from the traits to the skills
commentary: What I can actually do, then.

action: press 'slash' -- open the filter on this list
commentary: There is one thing here I have already done for real.
Swimming. Twice over the side in nine years, and twice back aboard.

action: press 'slash' -- reopen the filter so I can empty it
press 'BackSpace' -- rub out a letter; nothing on the screen changed
press 'BackSpace' -- rub out the last letter; nothing on the screen changed

commentary: Show me the whole of it.

action: press 'm' -- type over what is already there

commentary: Nine years I kept that diesel turning over with my hands and my ears.

action: press 'plus' -- put my hands on it properly
commentary: I know what a bad bearing sounds like before I ever see it.

action: press 'slash' -- reopen the filter for one more
press 'f' -- type over what is there

commentary: Mending. Nets, line, canvas. A boat is held together by whoever is aboard her.
I have spliced line in the dark with cold hands. It counts for something.

action: press 'a' -- ask it how old I am
commentary: Fifty-two years, and most of them wet.

action: press '5' -- type over the number it guessed

commentary: Thirty-one of those seasons out of Gloucester, and nine on my own keel.

action: press 'n' -- ask it what to call me
commentary: They ought to know what to call me.

action: press 'space' -- leave a gap before the rest; nothing on the screen changed
commentary: And my father name after it.
Odette Vachon. Out of Gloucester, and before that out of Cheticamp.

action: press 'at' -- put right what it has wrong about me
commentary: It has me down wrong. I am a woman, and fifty-two years of one.

action: press 'Tab' -- look over the whole of it before I commit
commentary: Let me see all of it laid out before I say yes.

action: press 'Tab' -- say that is the whole of me
commentary: That is the whole of me. Nothing left to add that would be true.

action: press 'Y' -- yes, let the rest go
commentary: Yes. Let it go. I am not going to pretend to be better than I am.
Yes. Salem is south of here, and Camille is somewhere in it.

action: press 'w' -- reach for something that is actually a weapon
commentary: A rod is for fish. Give me the knife.

action: press 'slash' -- filter down to the one I want
press 'Return' -- narrow the list to it

commentary: It cuts. That is all I need it to do.

action: press 'w' -- ask again for the knife; nothing on the screen changed
press 'Return' -- narrow to the knife alone
commentary: That one, and nothing else on the list.

action: press 'Right' -- take it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'w' -- once more, slowly; nothing on the screen changed
press 'question' -- find out how this is properly done
commentary: Let me find out how this is properly done.

action: press 'Escape' -- close that and look at where I actually am
commentary: Enough of that. Where am I standing.

action: press 'Return' -- put the rod down first, then; nothing on the screen changed
commentary: Put the rod down first, then.

action: press 'Down' -- look for what it is offering me; nothing on the screen changed
commentary: There must be something on this list.

action: press 'Escape' -- leave it, the rod will do
commentary: Leave it. The rod will do, and my hands know it better anyway.

action: press 'Left' -- step away from the shopfront; nothing in the map column changed
commentary: Whatever is out there is out the front. So I go the other way.

action: press 'apostrophe' -- acknowledge them without switching off my guard; nothing in the map column changed
commentary: I can see them. Seventeen yards is not close enough to freeze over, and I am keeping my ears open for anything new.

action: press 'Left' -- step away from the shopfront
commentary: Whatever is out there is out the front. So I go the other way.

action: press 'Up' -- north along the inside wall; nothing in the map column changed
commentary: North, along the inside wall, away from that big window.

action: press 'Up' -- further back; nothing in the map column changed
commentary: Further back. Glass is no kind of wall.

action: press 'exclam' -- stop the alarm telling me what I can already see; nothing in the map column changed
commentary: I know they are there. I do not need telling every time I lift a foot. I have my own eyes.

action: press 'Up' -- north one step, there is a back door in this wall
commentary: North one step. There is a back door in this wall.
Someone bled in here, and not recently. I would still rather be in here than out front.

action: press 'c' -- close the door behind me
commentary: Close it behind me. No sense advertising.
Sit tight. Listen. That is most of what fishing ever was.
Wait a while, then. I have done nothing else for thirty-one years.

action: press '7' -- three hours, and let the street get bored of itself
commentary: Three hours. Let the street get bored of itself.

action: press 'I' -- let the groaning be, and keep still
commentary: Groaning. Of course there is groaning. If I jump at every one of those I will never close my eyes again.
Nothing has come through that door. Again, then.
Six hours. The afternoon can have itself.
Still nothing at that door. Good.

action: press 'Right' -- back in through that door
commentary: Back inside. A door between me and the street is worth more than fresh air.

action: press 'c' -- and shut it; nothing in the map column changed
commentary: And shut. I will find water at first light, not at dusk.

action: press 'Right' -- through properly, off the threshold
commentary: Through properly. I was standing in the doorway like a fool.

action: press 'c' -- now shut it behind me
press 'bar' -- one thing before I lie down
commentary: One thing before I lie down.
Set the alarm. Water is the first job tomorrow and I want daylight for it.
Dawn. Ten hours and change. If I am still breathing then, water is the first thing.

action: press 'dollar' -- lie down and try to sleep
commentary: I sleep like the dead. Tonight that may be a mercy or it may be the end of me.
Yes. Down on the boards with my back against the wall, the way I slept in the wheelhouse for nine years.

action: press 'H' -- no, I already set it for dawn; nothing on the screen changed
commentary: I already set it. Dawn, and not a minute of it wasted.

action: press 'N' -- no second alarm, the dawn one will do
commentary: No. The one I set will do. Goodnight, then, whatever that is worth in here.

action: press 'Y' -- yes, stop, something just bit at me
commentary: Something just tried to take a piece out of me in the dark. I am awake. I am very awake.

action: press 'Left' -- two dogs and the dead behind them, get to the door
commentary: Two dogs on me and the dead coming up behind them. The door. Get the door open.

action: press 'Left' -- stand in the doorway itself
commentary: Stand in it. In a doorway they can only come at me one at a time, and my back is my own.

action: press 'Left' -- out, one more step and the door is between us
commentary: Out. One more step and there is a door between us.

action: press 'c' -- shut it on them; nothing in the map column changed
commentary: Shut it. A dog cannot work a handle. That is the whole of my plan and it will have to do.

action: press 'Right' -- swing at the one in the doorway
commentary: I cannot outrun a dog. But only one of them fits through that door at a time, and I have six feet of rod.
Again. Keep it in the gap.
Keep it in the gap. Do not let it past me.
Six at a time. It has maybe thirty in it. I can count.
My arm is bleeding. Keep swinging.
One of us is going to stop first.

action: press 'Up' -- no, I am not winning this, get out into the open
commentary: No. I am not winning this. My right arm is going. Out into the open.
Move. The dead are slow. The dogs are not, but the dead are slow and there are more of them.

action: press 'Escape' -- clear that away, I have no time for it
commentary: One. That is one. I have no time to be proud of it.

action: press 'Up' -- the dogs are off me, keep walking
commentary: The dogs are off me. One of them is not getting up again. Walk.
North. Steady. Do not run out of breath.
The dead do not hurry and neither will I.
Northwest, off this concrete and away from that shopfront.

action: press 'Up' -- a hardware store, of all places; nothing in the map column changed
commentary: A home improvement store. Of all the places to be chased into, that is the one I would have picked.

action: press 'Up' -- get in among the racking; nothing in the map column changed
commentary: Get in among the racking. I know my way around a place like this.

action: press 'Up' -- further in; nothing in the map column changed
commentary: Further in. Away from the glass.

action: press 'Up' -- deeper; nothing in the map column changed
press 'Left' -- that is a wall, go along it instead
commentary: That is a wall, not a way in. Along it, then.
West. There will be a door in it somewhere.

action: press 'y' -- northwest; nothing in the map column changed
press 'y' -- keep going; nothing in the map column changed
commentary: Keep going. They are behind me and they are slow.
West, along the brick, feeling for a door with my eyes.
My arm is stiffening up. Keep walking.
Thirty-one years of standing on a wet deck. I can walk.

action: press 'Left' -- west onto the road, away from the mass of them
commentary: West, onto the road. There are more of them behind me than I can count and I am not going to try.
One foot then the other. That is all it has ever been.
I am fifty-two and my arm is ruined and I am still walking.

action: press 'Left' -- something has my leg, pull free and keep going
commentary: Something has my leg. Pull. Pull and keep going.
West, and do not look back at it.
The arm is worse. I can still hold the rod in the left.
They are falling behind. Slowly, but they are.

action: press 'Down' -- turn on the dog, it is the only thing fast enough to follow me
commentary: The dog is the only one of them quick enough to keep up. So the dog goes first.
Swing. My waders have taken every bite so far.
Again. I did this once already tonight.

action: press 'n' -- southeast is the only side of me that is clear
commentary: Southeast is the only side of me with nothing on it. Go. Go now.

action: press 'n' -- keep going while my legs will carry me
commentary: My wind is going. Thirty-one seasons and it is my wind that goes first.
Camille. If anyone ever tells you anything about me, tell her I was walking toward her.

action: press 'Down' -- turn and face them, I will not be taken from behind
commentary: No more running. I have no wind left and they are on every side of me but one. Turn and face it.
Thirty-one seasons on the North Atlantic. I was never once taken from behind and I will not start tonight.

action: press 'Down' -- swing; nothing on the screen changed
press 'Y' -- yes, with my hands then
commentary: They have my rod and they have my arms and I cannot breathe. Then my hands. Yes.

action: press 'Down' -- hit it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'I' -- stop asking me and let me swing
commentary: Stop asking me. Let me swing.

action: press 'Down' -- hit it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'Down' -- hit it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'C' -- my last words, and there is only one name for them
commentary: There is only one name worth spending my last breath on.

action: press 'period' -- and that is the whole of it
press 'Return' -- set it down and let go
commentary: That is the whole of it. Set it down and let go.

action: press 'N' -- no, I do not need it played back to me
commentary: No. I was there for it.

action: press 'Escape' -- close the record of it
commentary: That is the record of it. Close it.

action: press 'N' -- no, what I said stands
commentary: No. What I said stands, and it was one word.
A tally. One dog. Nine hours. That is what I was worth on the day.

action: press 'Escape' -- close the last of it
commentary: Forgotten among the billions. Perhaps. Camille would have known where I was going and that is enough.

action: press 'Escape' -- close the follower epilogue and let the record end
commentary: Forgotten among the billions. Perhaps. Camille would have known where I was going, and that is enough for me.
